basic_profile.bio: I'm a software developer based in the Midwest, with a passion for both technology and paleontology. By day, I work as a Python developer at a mid-sized tech firm, and by night, I enjoy diving into dinosaur-related content and building intricate Department 56 village displays. My weekends often involve exploring local thrift shops for vintage model finds or enjoying a good read on Assyrian history. I'm in a committed relationship and love spending time discussing weather patterns with my partner, especially during storm season. Typically, I'm online during the evenings after work, around 6-10 PM CST.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a formal education in Computer Science, with a specialization in software engineering. Over the years, I've built a strong expertise in Python through both professional work and self-study. My interest in historical topics, like Assyria, stems from extensive reading and participation in related online forums. My fascination with weather patterns is a hobby I've nurtured through self-teaching and community engagement.
